annotations.title: Prepare connected video shots from a text group

description: Create ready-to-generate video shot nodes connected to text nodes inside a selected text group. This only prepares nodes; it does not submit paid video jobs. Requires the latest canvas revision. Returns shot node IDs, source node ID, optional stitch/group IDs and revision.

aspectRatio.description: Output width-to-height ratio supported by the selected model, such as 1:1 or 9:16.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

modelId.description: Canonical model ID returned by model discovery or resolution; preserve the user’s selected model.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

duration.description: Requested video duration in seconds, supported by the selected model.

prompt.description: Complete creative instructions for this output; describe the subject, composition and requested result.

sourceTextNodeId.description: Existing text node ID containing the source text for this storyboard shot.

sourceNodeId.description: Existing canvas source node ID to use for this operation.

name: playground_storyboard_prepare
title: Prepare connected video shots from a text group
